newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks rally in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks rally in morning trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks rallied strongly after a weak opening on Monday morning, chiefly due to a bullish view on the Hong Kong property market,brokers said
"The market is especially bullish about the outlook for investment property company earnings," said a broker with a Singaporean house.
The Hang Seng Index advanced 78 points to 12,967.67 in the first hour of trade on strong turnover of HK$2.24 billion.
Blue chips Sun Hung Kai Properties and Hysan are up, and even third line Chinese Estates, chiefly on the improving outlook for returns on commercial property, the broker said.
Sun Hung Kai Properties jumped HK$2.50 to HK$93.00, a new all time high for the share. Hysan also hit a new high of HK$28.15 then eased to trade HK$0.65 up at HK$28.10.

Meanwhile, the market's leading finance counters, HSBC Holding and Hang Seng Bank were lower due in part to the perception that a strong pound would have a seemingly negative impact on the banks' consolidated earnings, one broker said.
HSBC Holdings was off HK$0.50 at HK$159.50 and Hang Seng Bank down HK$0.50 at HK$94.25.
